title: Add configurable summarize settings
objective: Add one canonical summarize settings/defaults JSON asset, resolve default provider/model/thinking values through the configured summarize request directory, and accept summarize-specific command-line overrides while preserving existing source modes, completion behavior, and output formats.

branch.name: wi-0013-summarize-settings
branch.rationale: The work item records a bounded summarize settings feature without creating or switching a branch during intake.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* that accomplishes the following:

Add a summarize.settings.json to requests/summarize to support default model settings
Update llm summarize to consult the summarize.defaults.json
Update llm summarize to accept settings, such as provider/model/thinking via command line arguments

Commit the work item.

scope.name: summarize-settings-asset
scope.description: Add one canonical JSON settings/defaults asset under the configured requests/summarize directory containing bounded default provider, model, and thinking values.
scope.reason: The summarize command needs repository-owned defaults without hard-coding a deployment-specific model configuration.

scope.name: settings-name-clarification
scope.description: Use summarize.defaults.json as the canonical settings asset; do not create or consult summarize.settings.json.
scope.reason: Reading or adding two similarly purposed assets would create ambiguous configuration behavior.

scope.name: summarize-default-resolution
scope.description: Load and validate the canonical summarize settings asset through the existing configured requestsDirectory boundary.
scope.reason: Request assets must remain relocatable and use the established configuration convention.

scope.name: summarize-cli-overrides
scope.description: Accept summarize-specific provider, model, and thinking command-line settings and apply them as explicit overrides.
scope.reason: Operators need per-invocation control without editing repository-owned defaults.

scope.name: settings-precedence-and-regression
scope.description: Define settings precedence and preserve existing summarize source construction, completion behavior, and raw/full output formats.
scope.reason: Defaults and overrides must be predictable without regressing path, content, directory, or symlink-file behavior.

nonGoals.name: generic-request-contract-change
nonGoals.description: Do not change the versioned request schema, provider interface, completion response envelope, or generic normalizer contract.
nonGoals.reason: The feature is a summarize-command adaptation over existing request fields.

nonGoals.name: other-command-settings
nonGoals.description: Do not add settings-file or provider/model/thinking flag behavior to prompt, chat, continuation, or request-file commands.
nonGoals.reason: The requested settings boundary is limited to llm summarize.

nonGoals.name: configuration-precedence-redesign
nonGoals.description: Do not invent another configuration lookup mechanism or alter nodejs-common requestsDirectory precedence.
nonGoals.reason: The settings asset must remain relocatable under the established request-directory boundary.

nonGoals.name: credentials-and-arbitrary-settings
nonGoals.description: Do not persist credentials or add unrestricted settings passthrough, interactive prompts, or unapproved environment precedence.
nonGoals.reason: The settings asset is limited to bounded provider/model/thinking defaults and explicit CLI overrides.

nonGoals.name: operational-expansion
nonGoals.description: Do not publish, deploy, make authenticated provider calls, or claim production readiness.

items.name: canonical-settings-asset
items.description: The repository contains one canonical summarize settings/defaults JSON asset under requests/summarize with bounded provider, model, and thinking defaults.
items.reason: The command needs explicit repository-owned defaults and the request currently names two conflicting asset filenames.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The implementation creates and consults requests/summarize/summarize.defaults.json, rejects malformed or unsupported settings, and does not create or consult summarize.settings.json.

items.name: configured-default-resolution
items.description: llm summarize resolves the canonical settings asset beneath the requestsDirectory selected by the existing configuration convention.
items.reason: Settings must follow the same relocatable request-asset boundary as the summarize prompt and output schema.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Provider-free tests prove the configured requests directory is used, missing settings produce bounded actionable configuration errors, and valid defaults reach the constructed provider request.

items.name: summarize-cli-settings
items.description: llm summarize accepts provider, model, and thinking settings through command-line arguments with explicit validation.
items.reason: Operators need per-invocation settings overrides without mutating the defaults asset.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Argument tests prove valid --provider, --model, and --thinking values are captured for summarize, while missing values, duplicates, unsupported thinking values, and unknown summarize settings fail with usage/input errors.

items.name: settings-precedence
items.description: Explicit summarize command-line settings override settings-asset defaults, and omitted values continue through the defined defaults chain to existing runtime defaults.
items.reason: Precedence must be deterministic when only some settings are supplied on the command line.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Provider-boundary tests cover all combinations of asset defaults and partial CLI overrides and assert the final provider/model/thinking values.

items.name: summarize-regression
items.description: Settings support does not change existing summarize source modes, recursive directory file collection, final symlink-file handling, completion invocation, or raw/full output behavior.
items.reason: The feature must remain additive to the current summarize command.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Existing summarize tests and new settings tests pass for --path file, --path directory, symlink file, --content, raw output, full output, and provider-free completion boundaries.

items.name: scope-and-quality
items.description: The implementation remains limited to summarize settings integration and directly necessary tests/assets without generic provider or configuration-convention changes.
items.reason: The operator requested a bounded settings feature rather than a broader configuration redesign.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Changed-path review identifies only summarize settings integration, the canonical settings asset, and directly necessary tests or help text; typecheck, tests, build, and whitespace checks pass.
